creatures.name: Meadow Bunny
creatures.desc: Twitchy ears, a cotton tail and a deep love of clover. It thumps once when it is happy.

creatures.name: Songfinch
creatures.desc: It sings three rising notes at sunrise, as if counting the waystones.

creatures.name: Lantern Moth
creatures.desc: Its wings hold a little leftover moonlight. It circles anything that glows.

creatures.name: Moss Hedgehog
creatures.desc: Soft green moss grows between its spines. It naps in the roots of old trees.

creatures.name: Creek Otter
creatures.desc: It floats on its back and juggles pebbles. Every otter has a favourite stone.

creatures.name: Crystal Frog
creatures.desc: Its croak rings like a tiny bell. Crystals hum along when it sings.

creatures.name: Mist Deer
creatures.desc: It steps so softly that the fog barely moves. Stand still and it may come closer.

creatures.name: Ember Fox
creatures.desc: Its tail glows faintly at the tip, like a coal that remembers a warm fire.

creatures.name: Hush Owl
creatures.desc: It hoots once for every star it can see, then loses count and starts again.

creatures.name: Puffcone Squirrel
creatures.desc: It hides pinecones everywhere and forgets most of them, which is how new pines grow.

creatures.name: Sand Crab
creatures.desc: It walks sideways to keep one eye on the sea and one on you.

creatures.name: Tide Plover
creatures.desc: It races the little waves up and down the beach and always wins.

creatures.name: Drift Turtle
creatures.desc: Very old and very calm. Barnacles on its shell spell out a map nobody can read.

creatures.name: Moon Hare
creatures.desc: It only comes out when the moon is up, and its fur shines faintly silver.

creatures.name: Rain Snail
creatures.desc: It appears only in the rain, carrying its spiral house very slowly and very proudly.

creatures.name: Snowpuff
creatures.desc: A round little bird that looks like a snowball until it blinks.

creatures.name: Aurora Stag
creatures.desc: It appeared the night the light came home. Its antlers shimmer with the colors of the aurora.
